facts.headline: Lombard Launches Security Consortium to Strengthen Bitcoin's DeFi Integration
facts.summary: Lombard has launched the Lombard Security Consortium, a validator network of firms like Galaxy and others meant to secure LBTC and pull Bitcoin deeper into DeFi lending, staking, and yield. It addresses a real bottleneck—Bitcoin's weak DeFi presence—by rebuilding the trusted intermediaries crypto set out to remove.
